evidence_reviewed: main branch protection and commit-status metadata

notes: Provides structured conflict, chokepoint, sanctions, energy, trade, cyber, disaster and other public-intelligence surfaces suitable for contextual research.
Cross-stream correlation can help label the environment around market moves, but it is not itself evidence of causal return prediction.
Any future use must preserve timestamps, source attribution, freshness state and an explicit non-directional context boundary.
MCP cache envelopes expose cached_at and stale state, with stale able to reflect fetch age, minimum-record coverage, and upstream content age.
News paths attach source provenance and credibility metadata, and some data paths explicitly suppress non-redistributable provider data.
These semantics are useful as a reference for a future fail-closed external-context envelope in Crypto Autopilot.
CII v8 blends a curated baseline with live event pressure, supplemental boosts and conflict/advisory floors for 31 curated Tier-1 countries.
The score is a situational-risk index, not a calibrated probability of crypto return, volatility, direction or liquidation risk.
dynamicScore is an approximate 24-hour movement delta and can be zero during cold start or when no valid comparison snapshot exists, so it must not be treated as a complete time-series signal.
World Monitor market data is a mixed-asset aggregation layer and its MCP market tool is intentionally a fixed-universe cache read rather than a native exchange-history feed.
Crypto quote surfaces use upstream providers such as CoinGecko and CoinPaprika and therefore do not prove Binance USD-M or Pionex native provenance/equivalence.
It must not replace canonical OHLCV, funding, mark-price, open-interest, order-flow, provider-equivalence or backtest-admission evidence in Crypto Autopilot.
World and country briefs include AI-synthesized text grounded to source feeds and the project has explicit citation-grounding controls.
The upstream project has also documented prior unsupported-citation findings and subsequently tightened withholding rules.
Generated prose therefore remains a research summary surface and cannot directly authorize a directional signal, strategy change or trade plan.
The MCP server, REST API, CLI and SDKs make structured integration practical.
MCP tool calls require an API key or OAuth even though discovery can be public, which would add a new credentialed remote dependency and quota/plan surface.
No World Monitor API key, OAuth grant, network call, recurring job or production adapter is authorized by this evaluation.
Upstream source code is AGPL-3.0-only, so copying or deriving server/runtime code can create source-availability obligations that differ from Crypto Autopilot's existing code boundary.
World Monitor itself distinguishes providers whose terms permit redistribution and documents provider-specific restrictions for finance data.
A future integration must review API/product terms and per-source redistribution rights before persisting upstream-derived data into R2 or republishing it.
Premium stock-analysis and stock-backtest surfaces are designed for equities and do not replace the existing crypto strategy-research, frozen-partition or perpetual-cost model.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Build an isolated descriptive-context envelope using synthetic fixtures only. Require explicit observed/cached time, stale=false, source/provenance metadata and context type; reject missing freshness/provenance and reject any payload or configuration that claims strategy, promotion, formal backtest, trade-plan or live-trading authority. Do not call World Monitor, Binance, Pionex, R2 or frozen holdout during this contract step.
overall_decision.license_note: AGPL-3.0-only applies to World Monitor source code, while upstream data sources may have separate redistribution terms. Any future code reuse, remote API consumption, persistence or redistribution requires a separate license/terms review.
